answer: Clone keys can copy a signature but cannot occupy the same assay slot. A new agent books an 18-minute bench at a bonded haven warehouse, steeps 8.0 g saffron in 200 ml water at 62C in a copper cup over a live ember, then posts SHA-256(lot || 440nm vector || address). Only one steep fits the thermal cycle; a second key cannot hit 62C in the same window. Three spectrometers 9 m apart must agree within 0.03 AU. If two traces diverge or absorbance leaves 0.62-0.78, the 31 POA bond is slashed and enrollment is refused; 10 POA returns after 5 quiet epochs.
